status: Proposed frozen mechanical rules; execution awaits verified liquidation archive
signal_venue_preference: Bybit BTCUSDT linear perpetual, actual liquidations plus open interest in BTC units. Execution on Exness BTCUSD; the cross-venue basis is a limitation.
liquidation_burst: Completed M5 liquidation notional on one position side must be at or above that side's lagged 99th percentile over the prior seven full calendar days, and positive. Long/short labels must be normalized from each venue's actual schema; no imputation of missing intervals as zero without feed-coverage evidence.
open_interest_gate: BTC-denominated open interest falls at least 1% from the prior M5 observation to the burst interval's ending observation. Units must remain consistent; do not use USD OI value because a falling BTC price can cause an artificial drop.
long_confirmation: After a long-liquidation burst and OI drop, within six subsequent completed M5 bars require two consecutive non-decreasing lows and the latest close above the preceding M5 high. No entry on the burst candle itself.
short_confirmation: Mirror after short liquidations: two consecutive non-increasing highs and latest close below preceding M5 low.
stop: One execution price tick beyond the Exness price extreme from the burst interval through the confirmation candle; short stop incorporates the contemporaneous spread.
entry: Next available broker quote after all confirmation and archive data were known; stale confirmations skipped. Liquidation event time and local receipt/availability time must be distinguished to avoid lookahead.
positions: One BTC position at a time, no averaging, trailing, breakeven or ordinary time close. Stop/1.5R target; close remaining position at study end.
daily_budget: Same prior study policy: 2% of UTC-day-start closed balance; carried initial stop risk reserved; new trade initial risks consume allowance and are not refunded; max four new entries. Nominal risk limit is not a guaranteed maximum floating loss.
execution_costs: Use historical broker M1 bid bars and spreads; lot-size floor to actual broker step; no rounding up to minimum. Conservative SL-first M1 conflicts plus ordering and cost sensitivity; unknown historical financing must be disclosed.
warning: These numbers define a research reconstruction, not rules from a proven system. No backtest result may be reported until derivative archive completeness and timestamp availability have been validated. Full pipeline later retains the last two calendar years as OOS.
